words.meaning: A moment of sudden revelation or great insight.
words.sentence1: She had an epiphany while watching the sunrise over the quiet lake. (She had an epiphany while watching the sunrise over the quiet lake.)
words.sentence2: That sudden epiphany changed her perspective on daily life completely. (That sudden epiphany changed her perspective on daily life completely.)

words.meaning: Pertaining to twilight or dusk, bringing a sense of quiet wonder.
words.sentence1: El cielo crespuscular ilumina las nubes con tonos dorados. (The twilight sky illuminates the clouds with golden tones.)
words.sentence2: Disfrutamos de un paseo crespuscular por el jardín. (We enjoyed a twilight walk through the garden.)

words.meaning: Bright, colorful, and striking, often describing autumn leaves or vibrant nature.
words.sentence1: Les arbres flamboyants brillent sous le soleil d'automne. (The flamboyant trees shine under the autumn sun.)
words.sentence2: Un coucher de soleil flamboyant a clos notre journée. (A flamboyant sunset closed our day.)

words.meaning: A strong desire to travel and explore the world around us.
words.sentence1: Sein Wanderlust führte ihn in die entlegensten Bergdörfer. (His wanderlust led him to the most remote mountain villages.)
words.sentence2: Mit jedem Frühling erwacht ein neuer Wanderlust in ihrer Seele. (With every spring, a new wanderlust awakens in her soul.)

words.meaning: Evening twilight or dusk when the day gently transitions into night.
words.sentence1: Yūgure no sora wa utsukushii akairo ni somatta. (The evening twilight sky was dyed in a beautiful red color.)
words.sentence2: Watashitachi wa yūgure no machi o aruita. (We walked through the town at evening twilight.)

words.meaning: The morning, representing fresh beginnings and the beauty of a new day.
words.sentence1: Il mattino porta con sé la promessa di nuove meraviglie. (The morning brings with it the promise of new wonders.)
words.sentence2: Amo il silenzio del primo mattino. (I love the silence of the early morning.)

words.meaning: Sincerity and genuineness found in everyday human connection and wonder.
words.sentence1: Tā de chéngzhēn rang měi gè rén dōu gǎndào wēnnuǎn. (His sincerity made everyone feel warm.)
words.sentence2: Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, chéngzhēn shì zuì bǎoguì de pǐnxíng. (In daily life, sincerity is the most precious character trait.)

words.meaning: Glowing sunset or rosy clouds painted across the evening sky.
words.sentence1: Jeonyeok haneureul muldeurin noeuli cham areumdapda. (The glowing sunset staining the evening sky is truly beautiful.)
words.sentence2: Uri neun noeul eul barabomyeo georeotda. (We walked while gazing at the rosy sunset clouds.)

words.meaning: The sun, symbolizing light, warmth, and the daily wonder of life.
words.sentence1: Preah-arthit l-ong lica pi leu knong pnoh. (The sun rises brightly from behind the trees.)
words.sentence2: Phleang preah-arthit chha-laeng ban la-or nas. (The sunlight shines very beautifully.)

words.meaning: A starry night, evoking wonder at the vast cosmos above.
words.sentence1: Ons het lank onder die sterrenag gesels. (We talked for a long time under the starry night.)
words.sentence2: Die stilte van die sterrenag bring rus vir die siel. (The silence of the starry night brings peace to the soul.)
